items.heading: A Business Plan
items.text: A business plan is a short document that explains who your customer is, what you will sell and how you will earn more than it costs. For students, a plan is a way to test an idea cheaply.

items.heading: Write the Plan, Then Talk
items.text: Write the plan, then talk to ten possible customers and record what they said. Revise the offer after each conversation.
